title: Orthopedic Surgeons, Except Pediatric
description: Diagnose and perform surgery to treat and prevent rheumatic and other diseases in the musculoskeletal system.

tasks.text: Analyze patient's medical history, medication allergies, physical condition, and examination results to verify operation's necessity and to determine best procedure.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.text: Conduct research to develop and test surgical techniques that can improve operating procedures and outcomes related to musculoskeletal injuries and diseases.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Diagnose bodily disorders and orthopedic conditions, and provide treatments, such as medicines and surgeries, in clinics, hospital wards, or operating rooms.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Operate on patients to treat conditions.

tasks.text: Diagnose or treat disorders of the musculoskeletal system.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests differentials; clinician examines and owns diagnosis

tasks.text: Direct and coordinate activities of nurses, assistants, specialists, residents, and other medical staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient care supervision is live clinical leadership

tasks.text: Examine instruments, equipment, and operating room to ensure sterility.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Loading and operating sterilizing equipment by hand

tasks.text: Examine patient to obtain information on medical condition and surgical risk.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Patient physical assessment is hands-on clinical work

dwas.name: Examine patients to assess general physical condition.

tasks.text: Follow established surgical techniques during the operation.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI recalls protocols; execution and accountability are human

dwas.name: Follow protocols or regulations for healthcare activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Manage surgery services, including planning, scheduling and coordination, determination of procedures, or procurement of supplies and equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical supply ordering via systems; human approves

tasks.text: Operate on patient's musculoskeletal system to correct deformities, repair injuries, prevent and treat diseases, or improve or restore patient's functions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surgery is physical and high-accountability

dwas.name: Operate on patients to treat conditions.

tasks.text: Order and interpret the results of laboratory tests and diagnostic imaging procedures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

tasks.text: Prescribe preoperative and postoperative treatments and procedures, such as sedatives, diets, antibiotics, or preparation and treatment of the patient's operative area.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing therapy requires licensed clinical accountability

tasks.text: Provide consultation and surgical assistance to other physicians and surgeons.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical advice needs licensed accountability and context

dwas.name: Advise medical personnel regarding healthcare issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Refer patient to medical specialist or other practitioners when necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.
